# naturetools

Tools for calculating and plotting COSEWIC Index of Area of Occupancy
(IAO) and Extent of Occurrence (EOO) ranges. Builds on the
[naturecounts](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturecounts/) package,
which provides data access, example data and tutorials.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("BirdsCanada/naturetools")
```

## Example

``` r

library(naturetools)

r <- cosewic_ranges(naturecounts::bcch)
cosewic_plot(r)
```

# Package index

## Learning about this package

- [`naturetools`](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturetools/reference/naturetools-package.md)
  [`naturetools-package`](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturetools/reference/naturetools-package.md)
  : Tools for COSEWIC assessments using NatureCounts data

## COSEWIC functions

Functions for helping with COSEWIC assessments

- [`cosewic_ranges()`](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturetools/reference/cosewic_ranges.md)
  : Calculate COSEWIC IAO and EOO
- [`cosewic_plot()`](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturetools/reference/cosewic_plot.md)
  : Plot COSEWIC IAO and EOO

## Helper functions

Functions for working with spatial data

- [`map_canada()`](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturetools/reference/map_canada.md)
  : Map of Canada
- [`grid_canada()`](https://birdscanada.github.io/naturetools/reference/grid_canada.md)
  : Create grid across Canada
